title: The Emberfall desktop app
text:
Emberfall installs like a real PC game.

✨ Windows: the downloaded Emberfall.exe now installs itself the first time you run it, with no administrator password: an Emberfall Online shortcut on your desktop and in the Start menu, and an entry in Settings > Apps so you can uninstall it like any other program
✨ Linux: the app adds itself to your applications menu, with its icon, the first time it runs
✨ The app checks for a newer version of itself each time it starts and tells you if there is one. The game inside it always updates automatically, as before
